jobs.title: Data Analyst / Produktledare för dataprodukter konsultuppdrag
jobs.description:
Data Analyst / Produktledare för dataprodukter – konsultuppdrag
  
Vi söker en erfaren Data Analyst / Produktledare för dataprodukter till ett spännande konsultuppdrag inom ett större transformationsprogram hos en kund inom energi\- och infrastruktursektorn.
  
Uppdraget passar dig som är analytiskt stark, trivs med komplexa datamiljöer och vill kombinera djup dataanalys med ett successivt större ansvar för utveckling och prioritering av dataprodukter.
  
**Uppdragsperiod:** 12 oktober 2026 – 31 mars 2027
  
**Omfattning:** Heltid
  
**Plats:** Stockholm / hybrid enligt överenskommelse
  
**Start:** 12 oktober 2026
  
**Sista ansökningsdag:** 8 oktober 2026
  
Om uppdraget
  
Kunden genomför en omfattande datatransformation inom ett affärskritiskt program med höga krav på datakvalitet, spårbarhet och data lineage genom hela värdekedjan.
  
Miljön omfattar stora datamängder, flera käll\- och målsystem, externa leverantörer, systemintegrationer och pågående datamigrering.
  
Rollen är uppdelad i två faser.
  
Fas 1 – Data / Information Analyst
  
Inledningsvis ligger fokus på att bygga upp en djup och verifierad förståelse för programmets data och säkerställa att informations\- och datamodeller överensstämmer med faktisk data.
  
  

**Du kommer bland annat att:**  

Genomföra data profiling, explorativ dataanalys och datavalidering.
  
Analysera data från flera system och datakällor.
  
Kartlägga och verifiera data lineage och faktiska dataflöden.
  
Verifiera informations\- och datamodeller mot faktisk data.
  
Analysera entiteter, attribut, relationer, nycklar och kardinaliteter.
  
Identifiera och dokumentera avvikelser mellan modeller och faktisk data.
  
Ta fram analyser och skript för att simulera, testa och validera datamigrering.
  
Identifiera och kvantifiera problem med datakvalitet samt föreslå förbättringsåtgärder.
  
Omsätta verksamhetskrav till konkreta dataanalyser och verifieringar.
  
Ta fram kvalitetsmått, KPI och visualiseringar som beslutsunderlag.
  
Dokumentera metoder, antaganden, analyser och resultat på ett strukturerat och spårbart sätt.
  
Vara en sakkunnig kontaktpunkt för frågor inom data, datakvalitet och dataspårbarhet.
  
  

Fas 2 – Produktledare för dataprodukter
  
När du har etablerat en djup förståelse för data, informationsmodeller och verksamhetens behov utvecklas rollen successivt mot ett produktledaransvar.
  
  

**Du kommer då bland annat att:**  

Äga och vidareutveckla roadmap för dataprodukter.
  
Prioritera och sekvensera utvecklings\- och förbättringsinitiativ.
  
Översätta verksamhetens behov till prioriterade utvecklingsområden.
  
Säkerställa att utvecklingen baseras på verifierad förståelse för data, datakvalitet och beroenden.
  
Samordna behov och prioriteringar mellan verksamhet, IT, interna team och externa leverantörer.
  
Bidra till att dataprodukterna stödjer programmets krav på kvalitet, spårbarhet och långsiktig utveckling.
  
  

Vi söker dig som har
  
Krav
  
Dokumenterad erfarenhet som Data Analyst, Information Analyst eller motsvarande.
  
Erfarenhet av data profiling, statistisk analys och datavalidering.
  
Praktisk och god erfarenhet av SQL.
  
Praktisk erfarenhet av Python eller R.
  
Erfarenhet av att verifiera informations\- eller datamodeller mot faktisk data.
  
Erfarenhet av analys av data från flera system och datakällor.
  
Erfarenhet av att identifiera avvikelser, beroenden och datakvalitetsproblem.
  
Förmåga att förstå verksamhetskrav och omsätta dem till konkreta analyser.
  
Mycket god analytisk förmåga och vana att arbeta strukturerat med stora datamängder.
  
  

Meriterande
  
  

**Det är extra intressant om du har erfarenhet av:**  

Datamigrering eller större datatransformationsprogram.
  
Data lineage och tillhörande verktyg eller metodik.
  
Komplexa miljöer med flera leverantörer, system och integrationer.
  
Energi, finans, offentlig sektor eller andra verksamheter med höga krav på datakvalitet och spårbarhet.
  
Produktledning eller utveckling av dataprodukter.
  
Roadmap, backlog\-prioritering och koordinering mellan verksamhet och IT.
  
  

Som person tror vi att du är
  
Du är nyfiken och grundlig och tycker om att förstå komplexa dataområden på djupet. Du arbetar strukturerat och dokumenterar dina analyser och slutsatser på ett sätt som gör dem spårbara och återanvändbara.
  
Du är kommunikativ och kan förklara tekniska och statistiska resonemang för verksamheten samtidigt som du kan omsätta verksamhetens behov till konkreta datafrågor.
  
Du är självgående, ansvarstagande och bekväm med att samarbeta med både interna team och externa leverantörer.
  
Rollen passar särskilt bra för dig som vill kombinera hands\-on dataanalys med möjligheten att successivt ta ett större produktledaransvar för dataprodukter.
  
Övrigt
  
För uppdraget kan kundspecifika säkerhetsutbildningar och behörighetskrav behöva genomföras innan tillträde till kundens lokaler eller anläggningar.
  
I samband med presentation till kund kan CV samt ifylld kravmatris komma att efterfrågas.

jobs.title: SEB Corporate & Investment Banking Summer Internship 2027: Data analyst | SEB, Stockholm
jobs.description:
Are you ready to dive into the dynamic world of banking and finance? SEB’s Corporate \& Investment Banking (CIB) division offers talented students an exciting opportunity to gain hands\-on experience and grow their potential over a few intense summer months. If you have the ambition, we will support you every step of the way!


**The internship in short**



The programme kicks off with an engaging Introduction Week, where you’ll get to know SEB, meet professionals across the CIB division, get to know other interns and start building your network. During the introduction you will participate in learning and networking activities. We wrap up the experience with a Closing Day to reflect on, share, and celebrate your internship journey.  

As an intern, you are recruited to a specific job role where you will be involved in daily business activities and have a great opportunity to explore the environment of banking. You will be guided by at least one tutor during your internship.
  

For more details visit our webpage here.


**Fixed Income Business and Product Development Team**



The Fixed Income Business \& Product Development Team focuses on driving business growth, innovation, and operational excellence across SEB's Fixed Income franchise.



The team works closely with Trading, Sales, Technology, and Operations to develop and enhance electronic trading, market data, primary markets, and related fixed income products. It is responsible for defining product strategy, leading change initiatives, improving transparency across the value chain, and ensuring efficient delivery of business capabilities.



The team also leverages data, automation, and AI\-driven solutions to streamline processes, improve client satisfaction, and increase profitability. Through strong cross\-functional collaboration, the team helps translate business needs into scalable solutions that support SEB's Fixed Income business objectives.

  

**What You Will Do**


**Data Analytics:** Develop reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using Excel, Python, SQL, (and good to have but not mandatory with Tableau, BI tools and VBA).


**Project Work:** Communicate with trading desk and sales desk members to understand business requirements and turn them into business case for reporting or dashboard developments


**Team Collaboration:** Support Business Analysts and Project Manager with tasks such as data analysis, issue investigation

  

**Who Are You?**



We are looking for an **ambitious and focused individual** with a genuine interest in financial markets and technology. You are creative, proactive, and a team player. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail are essential. Experience with data analysis and presentation is a plus.


**Qualifications**


* Currently pursuing a master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Industrial Economics, Engineering or a related field.


* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and clients.


* A proactive mindset with the ability to take initiative and drive projects forward.


* Experience with data analysis and visualization tools such as SQL, Python, etc.



**Learn more about working at SEB** **www.sebgroup.com/career**



It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value\-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.


**Welcome with your application**



We look forward to receiving your application! Please make sure to include the following documents as **one combined file**:


* Your CV (not a LinkedIn profile), with your GPA clearly stated


* Grade transcripts from university


* A 100\-word paragraph outlining your motivation and interest (*space dedicated for it in the application form*)



Please note that applications submitted without a CV will not be considered.



Submit your application as soon as possible, but **no later than 12th October 2026** at 23:59 CET.


If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact career@seb.se

  



Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.

jobs.title: Business Analyst AI
jobs.description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next\-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.


Shape the future of global warranty operations through AI, data, and business analysis. We are seeking a Business Analyst to translate strategic business needs into scalable, value\-driven solutions that improve the consistency, accuracy, and efficiency of warranty handling.

 **About the Role**  

In this high\-impact role, you will lead the business analysis required to advance our AI\-enabled warranty process. Acting as the key interface between Warranty Operations, Sales Areas, end users, IT, and product teams, you will convert insights into prioritized requirements, use cases, and measurable business outcomes while driving process adoption and continuous improvement.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate warranty process adoption, compliance, performance, and recommend targeted improvements.
* Conduct workflow mapping to identify pain points, improvement opportunities, and future\-state processes.
* Translate business needs into prioritized AI and analytics use cases, requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Build business cases and define key performance indicators to track value realization.
* Partner with business and technology teams to test, implement, and continuously improve solutions.
* Drive change through clear communication, stakeholder engagement, training, business readiness, and follow\-up.
* Support implementation planning and adoption roadmaps across different user groups and markets.
* Promote responsible AI through transparency, high\-quality data, human oversight, and consistent decision\-making.
**Who Are You?**  

You are a commercially minded and analytical professional who brings clarity to complex challenges. You combine strong business acumen with an understanding of warranty operations, data, digitalization, and AI, and can influence across functions in a global environment.

 **Qualifications**

* Proven experience in business analysis, process development, requirements management, or business\-led digital transformation.
* Good understanding of AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics and their application to business value.
* Strong capability in data analysis and performance measurement, with advanced Excel skills. Knowledge of Power BI and SQL is a plus
* Ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations and materials for executive management
* Experience in driving change management, user adoption, or business readiness initiatives.
* Knowledge of warranty, aftermarket, or service operations is an advantage.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with business, IT, and international stakeholders.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

 **What We Offer**  

You will join a global, cross\-functional environment where AI is transforming warranty operations. This is an opportunity to influence strategic processes and deliver measurable improvements in quality, customer experience, consistence, and cost efficiency.

 **Application**  

Ready to turn AI into measurable business impact? Apply now and help shape the future of global warranty operations.

  

Last application date: October 8, 2026\.

  

As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable

  

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

 **Who we are and what we believe in**  

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

  

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

  

At **Volvo Trucks** you will be part of leading the way towards a sustainable transport industry. For nearly a century we have been innovating for people – to make life easier, better and safer. Driving progress is our promise to customers, to the industry and to society. At Volvo Trucks we share a curiosity to learn, we work with passion and we embrace change to stay ahead. Join us, together we move the world we want to live in.

jobs.title: SEB Corporate & Investment Banking Summer Internship 2027: Quantitative Analyst, Risk Advisory | SEB, Stockholm
jobs.description:
Are you ready to dive into the dynamic world of banking and finance? SEB’s Corporate \& Investment Banking (CIB) division offers talented students an exciting opportunity to gain hands\-on experience and grow their potential over a few intense summer months. If you have the ambition, we will support you every step of the way!


**The internship in short**



As an intern, you will join FX Solutions and Risk Advisory Sweden within FICC Markets. Our team provides tailored financial risk management advice to some of the bank’s largest and most complex corporate clients, with a focus on risks related to foreign exchange, interest rates and commodities.  

You will be involved in daily business activities and have a great opportunity to explore the banking environment. You will work alongside experienced colleagues and be guided by at least one tutor during the internship.



The programme kicks off with an engaging Introduction Week, where you’ll get to know SEB, meet professionals across the CIB division, get to know other interns and start building your network. During the introduction you will participate in learning and networking activities. We wrap up the experience with a Closing Day to reflect on, share, and celebrate your internship journey.  

For more details visit our webpage here.

  

**FX Solutions and Risk Advisory Sweden**



Movements in foreign exchange rates, interest rates and commodity prices can have a significant impact on companies’ earnings, cash flows, balance sheets and financial performance. FX Solutions and Risk Advisory Sweden works closely with corporate clients to understand these exposures and develop tailored financial risk management and hedging strategies.



As a Quantitative Analyst within Risk Advisory, you will support the development and application of quantitative models and analytical tools used to assess clients’ financial risks across FICC markets. You will have the opportunity to apply your theoretical knowledge to real business challenges and help translate complex financial data and quantitative analysis into clear, actionable advice.



The role combines quantitative analysis with commercial problem\-solving. It offers an opportunity to deepen your understanding of financial markets, develop your modelling and programming skills, and gain first\-hand experience of how advanced analytics can support strategic client advisory.

  

**What you will do**



Quantitative analysis and model development: Analyse financial market data and develop, test and improve quantitative models and analytical tools used to quantify financial risks and evaluate risk management strategies.



Risk advisory: Support the development and evaluation of tailored risk management and hedging strategies across FICC markets.



Client material: Contribute to business cases, presentations and other advisory material that translate quantitative results into clear business insights.

  

**Who are you?**



We are looking for an ambitious and focused individual with a genuine interest in financial markets, quantitative analysis and corporate risk management. You combine strong analytical capabilities with business acumen and are motivated by using data and modelling to solve real\-world problems.



You are curious, proactive and comfortable taking responsibility for your work. You pay close attention to detail, enjoy working collaboratively and can communicate complex findings in a clear and accessible way.


**Qualifications**


* You are currently pursuing a master’s degree in a relevant field such as Engineering, Physics, Industrial Engineering and Management, Applied Mathematics, Finance or a related field.
* You have a genuine interest in financial markets and corporate financial risk management.
* You have experience with, or a strong interest in, programming, quantitative modelling and data analysis. Knowledge of Python is an advantage.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience creating presentations are advantages.
* You have strong interpersonal and communication skills and can collaborate effectively with colleagues from different areas.
* You are fluent in spoken and written Swedish and English.
* Previous relevant work experience or extracurricular engagement, such as involvement in a student association, is considered an advantage.

jobs.title: HR Business Analyst
jobs.description:
### **Your New Role**


We are looking for an experienced HR Business Analyst to join an ongoing HR system transformation project. In this role, you will help translate business needs and requirements into clear, structured and harmonized HR processes that support both strategic objectives and operational efficiency.


You will work closely with stakeholders across the organization, contributing throughout the transformation journey — from requirements gathering, process mapping and impact analysis to documentation, testing, rollout and stabilization. A key part of the role is ensuring a clear distinction between business requirements, solution design and technical implementation.


You will also support change activities by helping develop new ways of working, user and administrator guides, and processes that enable successful adoption of the new HR solution.

### **Company Presentation**


Our client is a large organization with an ongoing HR transformation aimed at developing and harmonizing processes and ways of working across the business. The assignment offers the opportunity to work in a complex, cross\-functional environment with both local and global stakeholders.

### **Good to Know**

**Scope of employment**: Full\-time, 100%  

**Type of contract**: Fixed\-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters  

**Working model**: Hybrid, approximately 3 days/week on\-site in Södertälje  

**Start date**: 2026\-10\-19 or as agreed  

**End date**: Estimated 15\-month assignment

### **To succeed in this role, you will need:**

* Experience working with business requirements, process development and/or process mapping
* Understanding of HR / People \& Culture processes from a business perspective
* Experience working with HR systems
* Strong documentation and analytical skills, with the ability to structure complex information clearly
* Experience with requirements mapping, workflows and impact assessments
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional and diverse stakeholder groups
* A structured, proactive and adaptable approach
* Experience with HR master data, integrations, complex transformation programmes and change activities is considered an advantage.

### **What we Offer**

* Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension
* Wellness allowance and employee discounts and offers via Benifex
* Flex pension and access to Lifeplan pension advisory service
* Additional compensation during parental leave
* Occupational health services
* Long\-term assignments and a dedicated Consultant Manager for personal support
* Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

### **We look forward to receiving your application**


We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.title: IT - Global IT Business Analyst
jobs.description:
CCM Hockey is present worldwide, we have offices in Canada, the United States, Sweden, Finland and Taiwan. Our headquarters are located in Montreal, where we create and develop our equipment. Our mission is to inspire dreams and empower every player to fulfill their passion while enjoying their game. Our team's vision is to be the leading brand on and off the ice, by delivering innovative products and outstanding experience to our athletes and partners everywhere, all while putting our employees and communities at the forefront. We aim to unlock the full potential of every CCM athlete from pond to forum by delivering innovation to maximize performance and ignite in them the self\-confidence to chase their dream. We’re looking for passionate players who share our core values and will help us become THE industry leader!
  
  

**At CCM Hockey, we live our values everyday:**  

**Authenticity:** Standing up for who you are, doing what you mean and what you believe in.
  
  

**Empowerment:** Through their unique contributions, each person is different, each person is important, and each person has the opportunity to make a difference.
  
  

**Teamwork:** A team that works together always beats a team of highly skilled individual players.
  
  

**Respect:** Valuing differences and allowing others to express themselves when working together, to achieve common goals, to grow and succeed as a company.
  
  

OBJECTIFS
  
The IT business analyst links the IT teams with the business departments, taking on more responsibility for managing small end\-to\-end projects, while bringing key expertise in supply chain and EDI integration. They actively take part in Agile delivery using Kanban, acting as a facilitator within the team.
  
RESPONSIBILITIES
  
* Conduct interviews with stakeholders to gather and clarify business needs
* Lead or participate in project planning (scope, timelines, deliverables)
* Act as a functional reference for supply chain processes and EDI integrations
* Document functional and non\-functional requirements
* Analyze, prioritize, and align needs with business goals
* Collaborate with IT teams, business units, and external partners to design effective solutions
* Produce detailed specifications for new systems and improvements
* Facilitate design workshops with development teams
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to ensure objectives are met
* Track initiative progress and communicate status to stakeholders
* Develop and execute test strategies (including UAT)
* Ensure deliverable quality and compliance


Agile Responsibilities (Kanban / “Light” Scrum Master)
  
* Help with delivery in an Agile environment (Kanban mode)
* Join team rituals (stand\-ups, prioritization, retrospectives)
* Help keep workflow smooth and remove blockers
* Work closely with the development team and stakeholders


QUALIFICATIONS
  
* Degree in computer science, information systems, business analysis, or a related field
* 5 to 10 years of experience in business analysis
* 1 to 2 years of experience in project management or coordination
* Hands\-on experience with EDI integrations
* Extensive experience and knowledge in supply chain
* Experience with an ERP (ideally Epicor)


At CCM Hockey, we celebrate the difference for the benefit of our employees, our products and our collaborators. We work to create an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, age or other motives, can give the best of themselves.

jobs.title: HR Business Analyst – Payroll & HR-system
jobs.description:
Vi söker nu en HR Business Analyst för ett längre konsultuppdrag hos en kund i södra Stockholm. Uppdraget är på heltid och genomförs huvudsakligen på plats, cirka tre dagar per vecka.


I rollen får du en central del i ett pågående transformationsarbete inom HR, med särskilt fokus på Payroll, HR\-processer och HR\-system. Du arbetar med att fånga och strukturera verksamhetens behov och omsätta dessa till tydliga krav, processer och arbetssätt.


Du kommer att arbeta genom hela förändringsresan – från kravinsamling och analys till processdesign, dokumentation, testning, införande och stabilisering. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med HR, projektorganisation, verksamhet och andra berörda intressenter. Du bidrar även till att nya processer och arbetssätt blir tydliga, förankrade och möjliga att använda i den dagliga verksamheten.

### **Vi söker dig som**

* Har erfarenhet av HR Business Analysis, processutveckling eller liknande roller.
* Har god praktisk förståelse för Payroll och HR\-administration.
* Har erfarenhet av att kartlägga, utveckla och dokumentera HR\- och löneprocesser.
* Är van att samla in och strukturera verksamhetskrav samt omsätta dem till processer och arbetssätt.
* Har erfarenhet av HR\- och lönesystem.
* Har arbetat i projekt, transformationer eller andra förändringsinitiativ.
* Är van att samarbeta med olika intressenter inom HR, verksamhet, projekt och förändring.
* Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.


Erfarenhet av exempelvis SD Worx, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Payroll eller motsvarande HR\- och lönesystem är meriterande.

### **För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du**


Är strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och trygg i att driva ditt arbete framåt även när förutsättningarna förändras. Du har lätt för att skapa struktur i komplexa frågor och samarbetar gärna med olika kompetenser och intressenter. Du är också kommunikativ och har förståelse för hur tydliga processer och bra dokumentation kan bidra till att nya system och arbetssätt blir förankrade och använda.

### **Om uppdraget**

**Plats:** Södra Stockholm, hybridarbete med cirka 3 dagar på plats per vecka

jobs.title: SEB Corporate & Investment Banking Summer Internship 2027: Quantitative analyst within Fixed Income | SEB, Stockholm
jobs.description:
Are you ready to dive into the dynamic world of banking and finance? SEB’s Corporate \& Investment Banking (CIB) division offers talented students an exciting opportunity to gain hands\-on experience and grow their potential over a few intense summer months. If you have the ambition, we will support you every step of the way!


**The internship in short**



The programme kicks off with an engaging Introduction Week, where you’ll get to know SEB, meet professionals across the CIB division, get to know other interns and start building your network. During the introduction you will participate in learning and networking activities. We wrap up the experience with a Closing Day to reflect on, share, and celebrate your internship journey.
  

As an intern, you are recruited to a specific job role where you will be involved in daily business activities and have a great opportunity to explore the environment of banking. You will be guided by at least one tutor during your internship.  

For more details visit our webpage here.

  

**About the position**



You will be joining a team of Quantitative analysts and be based in Stockholm. The Fixed Income Quant team is responsible for the pricing and risk models for all fixed income products including XVA, as well as the trading algorithms used for trade execution, market making and risk management. You will for example be introduced to and involved in the development of tools for pricing, P\&L and risk management of fixed income products and take part in the building of the fixed income platform for Trading. This includes analysis, configuration, implementation and testing of valuation models, yield curves or volatility surfaces, as well as supporting Sales and Trading with ad\-hoc analyses on an intra\-day basis.



Not only will you be part of a talented and diverse team of quantitative analysts, you will also work closely with all parts of the Fixed Income organization including Sales and Trading.

  

**Who are you?**



You are likely on your way to a M.Sc in engineering or natural science, with a passion for problem solving, mathematics and/or programming. Also, you are fluent in both written and spoken English.
  

As a person, you are motivated by working in a fast paced and dynamic environment where you can make a difference with your analytical skills. You are a team player who enjoy working as part of a team, have good communication skills, and have the ability to work under pressure.



**Learn more about working at SEB** **www.sebgroup.com/career**



It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value\-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.


**Welcome with your application**



We look forward to receiving your application! Please make sure to include the following documents as **one combined file**:


* Your CV (not a LinkedIn profile), with your GPA clearly stated


* Grade transcripts from university


* A 100\-word paragraph outlining your motivation and interest (*space dedicated for it in the application form*)



Please note that applications submitted without a CV will not be considered.



Submit your application as soon as possible, but **no later than 12th October 2026** at 23:59 CET.


If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact Morten Karlsmark at morten.karlsmark@seb.se

  



Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.


.

jobs.title: Associate Data Analyst
jobs.description:
SS\&C is a leading provider of mission\-critical, AI\-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid\-market firms, rely on SS\&C for expertise, scale, and technology.  



  

**Job Description**

  

**Get To Know Us:**

SS\&C is leading the way. We continue to look for today's and tomorrow’s brightest talent, those who embody a spirit to improve not only their lives, but those around them. From college students to seasoned and experienced professionals, we encourage you to apply. SS\&C prides itself on hiring diverse, honest, dynamic individuals who value collaboration, accountability, and innovation, to name a few.  



  

**Role:** **Associate – Data Analyst**
--------------------------------------

**Locations** : Copenhagen, Denmark \| Hybrid 6 days a month  

  



  

  

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a full\-time **Associate Data Analyst** to join our Copenhagen office and become part of a specialised, collaborative, and close\-knit team working at the intersection of finance, data analytics, and securities litigation.


As an Associate, you will contribute to a broad range of research and analytical activities, including evaluating securities class actions, estimating potential investor recoveries, analysing settlement opportunities, and supporting the identification and assessment of new business opportunities.


The position combines financial analysis, data analysis, litigation research, and business research. You will work with financial and trading data, legal and regulatory filings, institutional investor information, and internal analytical models to support the evaluation of complex litigation matters.


You will be given hands\-on responsibility from an early stage and gain broad exposure to securities markets, institutional investors, class action litigation, and data\-driven financial analysis.  



  

**What You Will Get To Do:**

* Assist with the calculation and analysis of potential damages and settlement recoveries in securities class actions, including securities fraud, IPO, merger, and other shareholder litigation matters.
* Collect, validate, and analyse financial, trading, market, and litigation data used in case evaluations and recovery estimates.
* Conduct research on securities class actions, court filings, settlement notices, regulatory filings, and relevant market developments.
* Review legal filings and settlement documentation to identify class definitions, relevant securities, eligibility requirements, and potential recovery opportunities.
* Assist with research and analysis of institutional investors and prospective clients, including their investment strategies, portfolio holdings, SEC filings, assets under management, and potential exposure to litigation opportunities.
* Support the development and maintenance of financial, statistical, and predictive models used to evaluate potential litigation outcomes, damages, and recoveries.
* Support the preparation and maintenance of loss estimates, price\-drop analyses, case valuations, and other internal and client\-facing analytics.
* Maintain and update internal databases and analytical tools relating to pending litigation, settlements, and institutional investors.
* Prepare tables, charts, calculations, and other analytical materials using Microsoft Excel and other data\-analysis tools.
* Perform ad hoc financial, litigation, and business research as required.
Contribute to the continued development and improvement of research processes, analytical methodologies, databases, and internal tools.  
* 

**What You Will Bring:**

We are looking for a candidate with a strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and an interest in working with financial information and complex datasets.


* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Law, or another relevant field.
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Experience working with data and the ability to analyse and interpret complex datasets.
* Strong research skills and the ability to collect, evaluate, and combine information from multiple sources.
* Excellent attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* The ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities effectively.
* The ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
A proactive approach, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to learn.  
* 

The following would be an advantage but is not required:


* Experience with SQL, Python, R, or other data\-analysis or statistical software.
* Experience in financial analysis, investment research, data analytics, business research, or a related area.
* Familiarity with SEC filings, including Forms 13F, 13D, and 13G.
* Knowledge of securities markets, institutional investment management, or financial instruments.
* Experience working with large financial or transactional datasets.
An interest in securities litigation, class actions, or litigation analytics.  
* 

**Why You Will Love It Here!**

* **Flexibility** : Hybrid Work Model
* **Your Future:** Professional Development Reimbursement, including access to SS\&C University
* **Work/Life Balance:** Competitive holiday scheme
* **Your Wellbeing:** Competitive benefits designed to support the wellbeing of our staff
* **Diversity \& Inclusion:** Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving on Diversity
* **Training:** Hands\-On, Team\-Customised throughout your career

*We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds to enable us to bring diverse perspectives to our thinking and conversation. It'

jobs.title: Strategic Business Analyst - SAP FI finance area (28716)
jobs.description:
This is an exciting time to become part of Tryg. With a strong Nordic focus on simplification, scalability and process optimization, our strategic ambition is to develop and improve customer and user experience by offering great digital solutions across the Nordics.  

We are investing in our Nordic finance system landscape and are expanding our team with a new Strategic Business Analyst colleague. Would you like to be a part of the development?  

**About the role \| Strategic Business Analyst with a Nordic SAP FI and finance focus**
As Strategic Business Analyst you have a solid knowledge of finance processes, finance ways of working, and the systems supporting these processes, especially SAP FI. You support the business in refining and describing EPIC’s while clarifying uncertainties and describing both functional and non\-functional requirements on EPIC level. As Strategic Business Analyst you participate in Epic maturation workshops, refinements and plannings. You assist in scoping and analyzing business needs, describe acceptance criteria’s to guide the development efforts in close collaboration with business units, architects and bridge between business, the technical team and relevant stakeholders whenever relevant.  

Your primary tasks and responsibilities will include:
* Scope, analyze business needs and break down EPIC’s
* Describe acceptance criteria’s to guide development efforts
* Ensure requirements are adhering to legal and compliant demands from both business and IT perspective
* Collaborate with Product Owners, stakeholders, developers and architects, ensuring that business needs are correctly understood, developed and implemented
* Assist on documenting findings, decisions, and requirements clearly and concisely
* Serve as a bridge between business users and stakeholders, ensuring alignment and facilitation collaboration across organizational boundaries
* Identify, communicate and facilitate dependencies between different business processes
  

The role as Strategic Business Analyst is a Nordic role based in Ballerup. We currently work from the office in Ballerup 3\-4 days per week.  

**About you \| Combining business understanding with technical insight**
You are motivated by working in an environment where business and technology meet. You enjoy scoping business needs, creating structure, driving progress, and bringing people together around a common requirement. You have experience with finance work processes, analysing business needs and translating into well described requirements.  

We imagine that you bring:
* Strong understanding of finance and accounting processes
* Solid knowledge with SAP, particularly SAP FI
* Experience as a Strategic Business Analyst, Business Analyst or similar role
* Are comfortable working in a complex system landscape
* Have experience working in agile environments
* A structured approach to your tasks, deadlines and knowledge sharing
* Comfortable with English both written and spoken as business language
* Able to speak and write a Nordic language is an advantage but not a requirement
  

Experience with SAP FS\-CD, BW, PI/PO, CPI, Concur, or Ariba is considered an advantage but is not required.  

**About us \| A collaborative Nordic environment**
As a Strategic Business Analyst, you will join Enterprise Solutions within Business IT Development (BID), where we develop and maintain a range of business\-critical Finance and HR systems.  

Our team consists of approximately 11 internal colleagues working closely with strategic partners across the Nordic region. Together, we support a complex finance landscape centred around SAP and integrated with many of Tryg's core business systems.  

At Tryg, we value trust, collaboration, and knowledge sharing. You'll have significant influence on a business\-critical product area, flexibility in how you work, and opportunities to develop professionally in a complex and evolving SAP landscape.  

**We look forward to hearing from you!**
Ready to grow your career and make an impact? Please, send your application and CV **no later than 19th of October 2026**. We encourage you not to attach a photo to your CV.  

We invite relevant candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application today. Once the right candidate has been found, the recruitment process will be closed.  

For questions about the role, contact: Teamlead \& Service Delivery Manager \- Finance \& HR Platforms – Tinne Kam – Tinne.kam@tryg.dk
